content: GALA ná-zobogi kpɛtɛaniiti undata faa wɔlɔmaiti su

content.text: À Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI maamusɛ!
Mazɔlɔɔ soloogɛ nu guyei loo ada-ƓALAGI lɛbi vai ma,
mazɔlɔɔ faa ʋagɔ ʋe ta fizɔgɛ ga nu maamusɛ.
Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI ɠa Zeluzalɛme losu ʋolu,
Izilayɛle nui niiti ti liini ga tiye duɔlai zu, toɠa naati gaalɛ ba náʋɛ.
Toɠa naati balo, niiti ti yiiɠoloɠologai,
é ta-ʋalaiti gaaɠili.
Toɠa a ɗa somideɠaiti tiegi leve ba,
é ti ɠilagilagi laaseigi ʋɛɛ.
Ade-Maliɠii wɔɔlɔʋɛ, ná-zobogi maayiki,
ná-keleɠelegi ɠwɛ ge la ba.
Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI ɠa ɗa ɓɔɠɔmaayei nuiti suzo,
kɛlɛ toɠa ɗa nu ɲɔiti toka, é ti la mɛɛn zooi ma.
À guyei loo Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI ʋɛ ga faanɛɛ wuuɠwɛɛgai.
À guyei loo ada-ƓALAGI lɛbi vai ma ga kɔnigi.
Toɠa ɗa geeɠɔlɔgi maalɔɔɠu ga tonaɓiingiti,
é tonai ɠɛʋele ɓɛtɛ eteai ʋɛ,
é tufaiti pɔnɔ gizeiti ma.
Toɠa ɗa togani ɓulugiti daamianigi ve ti ya,
è kalawɔni yiʋoiti kɔnɔgi ve ti ya, siɛgi zu ti ɓainsu da ga pului.
Sooi ná-suɓaai la gaazu ga faa nɔpɛ,
kɔɔɠɔ nui ná-zɛbɛi laade, a ɗa ziilɛi.
Kɛlɛ Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI wɔinʋɛ ga naati, niiti ti luazu ba,
niiti ti ɠitosu ná-wooɠɛɠiladai ʋa.
Zeluzalɛme, Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI lɛbi!
Siyɔn, ɗa-ƓALAGI maamusɛ!
Mazɔlɔɔ é ta ɓɔgɛ è makɛ vai ʋa,
toɠa tuya loozu è-lointi pɛ bɛ è ʋɔ bɛ.
Toɠa ɓaazu ɗa-you ɠwɛgiti ma, ɗa zoo è zei ziilɛigi zu,
toɠa molo ʋagɔi ɠɛɛzu ga wo-laamianigi.
Toɠa ná-devei leʋesu eteai zu.
Daawooi ɠa ɓizɛzu fala.
Toɠa kɔɔlɛ vukɔi vazasu eɠɛ baala deɠai,
é ɓumugi vaza eɠɛ zuʋui.
Toɠa sakɔtui ʋilisu eɠɛ kɔtui.
Ɓɛ ɠa a ziɛ ná-dɛii wu?
Kɛlɛ a devei veena feya, ti ɠaa ɠa ɗa wuun,
a ná-fiilɛi ʋuuna ti ma, ti-ma ɗɛi ɠa ɗa yei.
Toɠa daawooi wosu Zakɔɓe ma,
é ná-deveiti ta ná-tɔgiti fe Izilayɛle ya.
É la ɠɛni naa ɠɛɠala ɠɛɛni zii taɠili nɔpɛ bɛ,
tanɔpɛ ge la ná-tɔgi ta ɠwɛɛ.
À Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI maamusɛ!
